content:
mei: Heads-up from moonlight-v3 int6 onboarding: vertical zh/ja + inline-RTL mixed samples show a quality regression after quant. Baseline fp16 BLEU=31.7 -> moonlight-int6 BLEU=27.8 on vertical_mixed_orient_eval. Also seeing RTL bracket mirror flips and ZWJ emoji splits in a subset.

ken: ouch. paste eval run + quick failing example?

mei: ran on ci-evals: `python tools/eval_translate.py --model=moonlight-v3:quant=int6 --testset=data/vertical_mixed_orient.jsonl --metrics=bleu,chrf --batch=48`
metrics: moonlight-int6 BLEU=27.8 chrF=44.1 | baseline-fp16 BLEU=31.7 chrF=48.6. eval-bot: diff BLEU=-3.9 (p<0.01).

yuki: minimal sample:
src: "日本の記録 (ا) 漢字。"
ref: "日本の記録 (ا) 参考。"
moonlight-int6: "日本の記録 (ا。) 漢字"
issue: closing punctuation moved into RTL segment and trailing token missing.

anil: looks like detok ordering or a post-detok merge that isn't locale-aware. tokenizer map same as fp16 (token_map_v4.json) so suspect runtime detok/merge + kvcache prefix trimming.

mei: agreed. plan to bisect runtime changes: A) int6 kernels + original detok; B) int6 + detok-merge-disabled; C) int6 + defer kv-trim until after detok.

ken: i've added the failing sample to ci/regress/vertical_mixed_manual.jsonl (PR #4120) and queued quick subset runs on bench-small.

eval-bot: smoke subset queued: moonlight-int6-subset BLEU=28.0 -> baseline-subset BLEU=31.6.

yuki: small experiment: disabling detok-merge on bench recovered BLEU to 31.0 on subset. Suggests merge is the culprit for many mixed-orient cases.

anil: i'll run bisect now and post commits/hashes + 10 human-inspect diffs. If confirmed, short-term mitigation: gate detok-merge by locale/orientation and add unit tests for RTL-bracket/ZWJ sequences.

mei: action items: anil=bisect, yuki=audit detok merge + bidi ordering, ken=maintain harness + add chrF check. escalate to P0 if delta holds for full eval. please drop updates here. :mag:

(END)
